description: This file contains TypeScript code defining data schemas, functions, and types for interacting with OpenRouter models and endpoints, including fetching model data, parsing models, and handling model configurations.

methods.name: getOpenRouterModels
methods.description: Fetches and parses a list of OpenRouter models from the API, filtering out image models.

methods.name: getOpenRouterModelEndpoints
methods.description: Fetches and parses endpoints for a specific OpenRouter model by ID.

methods.name: parseOpenRouterModel
methods.description: Constructs a ModelInfo object from raw model data, applying special handling for certain models.
